title: Prudential Regulation Authority Business Plan 2026/27
summary: The PRA's 2026/27 Business Plan outlines regulatory priorities for the year, emphasizing safety and soundness of banking and insurance sectors alongside a drive for efficiency and reduced burden. The plan confirms ongoing Basel III implementation (finalized January 2026), a new simplified capital regime for small domestic banks effective January 2027, and continued work on liquidity standards responding to faster bank runs observed in 2023. The PRA regulates 1,254 firms (686 deposit-takers, 568 insurers) and is undertaking significant internal efficiencies including a ~140 staff headcount reduction.
key_points: PRA regulates 1,254 firms total: 686 deposit-takers and 568 insurers across all types

Basel III remaining elements finalized in rules published January 2026, with implementation proceeding through 2026/27; stated goal is capital requirements better reflecting underlying risks without increasing overall requirements
Simplified capital regime for small domestic banks finalized, full implementation from January 2027
Future Banking Data Programme aims to streamline regulatory reporting for banks
Insurance liquidity reporting introduced and being embedded; work on bank liquidity to respond to faster bank runs experienced mainly in US in 2023
PRA is considering responses to discussion paper on broadening UK life insurers' access to alternative capital, subject to policyholder protection safeguards
Internal efficiency: ~140 staff headcount reduction planned; Periodic Summary Meetings moving to two-year cycle; authorisations timeliness improving
CEO Sam Woods' term concludes June 2026; Katharine Braddick takes over in July 2026
why_it_matters: This business plan provides regulatory architecture for UK banking and insurance sectors. While not directly market-moving for trading, it signals the regulatory environment and supervisory priorities that will shape bank behavior, capital deployment, and insurance sector risk-taking through 2026/27. The Basel III completion and simplified small bank regime affect capital requirement calculations across the sector.
important_numbers: January 2027 for full implementation of simplified small bank capital regime
January 2026 for Basel III final rules
End of 2025 for Matching Adjustment Investment Accelerator launch
